latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of clawhub-publish skill.

- Publish OpenClaw skills to ClawHub with release checks and metadata validation.
- Generates a ready-to-run clawhub publish command after reviewing slug, name, version, changelog, and tags.
- Includes local release audits and confirms skill readiness before actual publish.
- Enforces semantic versioning recommendations and clear pre-publish checklists.
- Prevents unintended uploads by requiring user confirmation before publishing.
